title: Imagine If:
title_short: Balloons · GV · I Might Forgive Them
headline: A stranger explains why people do mean things, and chooses to forgive them.
story: GV talks about people who do bad things. Part of them does not want to. They need to be seen and taken seriously.
So GV says: I might forgive them. They might have their own bully in their own life. Then the balloons go up. One person, about 30 seconds.
do: Text on frame 1: “I MIGHT FORGIVE THEM.” Already on screen at 0:00.
End on “So even I empathize with that.”, then the balloons.
Use GV’s close shots in 764_3897 and 764_3898.
Cut from the MXF. Match the approved Balloon Release montage.
dont: No politics, no leaders, no names of groups. Keep “they” general.
Do not use the release seconds the Destiny video uses (764_3900 0:46.9–0:50 and 0:54–1:02).
No he/she on screen. Only “GV” if a name is ever needed, and no name super here.

files: SFCG — Shooting Brief: Peace Delivered + Imagine If (V1)
Not chosen yet. Guide for now: the approved Balloon Release montage (SFCGImagineIfBalloons001).
SFCG logo animation 9:16 · horizontal logo, white text (PNG). Branding and Font columns on Monday are empty.
Not set by the client. If you use a bed, keep it very soft and match the approved montage. Save the license with the project.
tech: Picture: 764 MXF files, 16:9. The Monday brief says 1920×1080, 23.98 fps. Our probe could only read the proxies (960×540, 23.976 fps, several mono audio tracks). Check the MXF in the NLE before you set the timeline.
1080×1920 at 23.976 fps. Same as the source. No conversion.
A 9:16 crop of 1080p is 608 px wide, so it is already upscaled 1.78×. Keep punch-ins at 110% or less. Sharpen lightly. 764_3897 and 764_3898 are close shots of GV: crop on the face.
Audio is in the camera. The MXF has several mono tracks. Solo each track and use the one with the clear voice. We did not measure the channels here.
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Any music 18–20 dB under the voice.
Royal-blue box #1E6FD6, white text, floating over the speaker. Max 2 lines. Keep the bottom 20% clear.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, about 16 Mbps. One file. 9:16 only. Deliver to Frame.io → Ready for Review.
checklist: Write “Search for Common Ground”: capital S, small “for”. Never SFCG, CGLA or a Preemptive Love logo on screen.
The hook text is already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on. No logo, title card, name or fade at 0:00.
Captions match the audio word for word. Keep the speaker’s own grammar.
No camera-shutter sounds. Every jump cut is covered.
No animation in the middle (Kalindi: “it was inauthentic”).
No name and no place name on screen.
End card: Search for Common Ground lockup + sfcg.org. Nothing under it.
Cut from the MXF in RAW, never from the proxy. 9:16 only.
“bully” and “empathize” checked by ear; captions match what is said.
Only GV speaks, plus Kalindi’s countdown.

decisions.b: The end card reads sfcg.org. Search is still building the Imagine If landing page (Yana owns it). One end-card pass across the batch when the link exists.

client_note: Why this matters: Kalindi asked for more balloon videos. GV gives the most Search-like idea of the day: understand the person who hurts you.
